findings.finding: The native template has Network Distribution (column77). Its SearchStandard sample leaves it blank; only the Shopping sample supplies the entire-network enum. The header is native-template evidence, while new SearchStandard value support comes from current Bulk documentation.

Supported Search network enums are OwnedAndOperatedOnly = Microsoft sites and select traffic, and OwnedAndOperatedAndSyndicatedSearch = entire Microsoft Advertising Network (default in Bulk). Neither label is a Google-style Search partners boolean.

Both native ad-distribution options include Search and Audience ads. OwnedAndOperatedOnly narrows partner distribution but does not establish search-results-only delivery; select partner traffic remains aggregated.

Native template also has generic Bid Adjustment (column41). Bulk help/current Bulk Ad Group docs describe -100..900 for Audience participation, with -100 exclusion; CMS calls it AudienceAdsBidAdjustment. Microsoft announced UI Audience modifier removal for all advertisers by February21,2023. Current importer acceptance, account availability and MaxClicks interaction are unproved; do not add -100, infer an opt-out, or use Content Network=off as a substitute.

SyndicatedSearchOnly is rejected since July2024 despite remaining in the schema; InHousePromotion is only for Shopping for brands. The September7,2026 NetworkDistributionSetting.NetworkOption remains Reserved, not a supported new Search/Audience control. No deprecated enum or reserved setting is proposed.
